meta.triageRationale: One story in one module with a clear approach: add REFERENCES (language sql) to Pass 2 of the cross-file pass with a name matcher over the repository's table/view entities; no storage or schema change.

body.summary: The cross-file pass now resolves pending SQL REFERENCES by name. REFERENCES joins PASS2_KINDS. The entity index gains sqlByName and sqlByLastSegment, and runPass2's dispatch gains a third arm, resolveSqlReference; only rows from a SQL entity are attempted. Matching: unquoted names compare case-insensitively; a qualified name matches only that definition; a bare name also matches any qualified definition ending in it. One candidate is written 'inferred', several stay ambiguous with their candidates, none is no-candidate (no-match). In settle mode, runPass2 also takes pending SQL references that a committed file's tables or views answer; rowsInScope is unchanged. The s9 assertion in sql-index.test.ts that cross-file references stay pending now expects inferred edges.
